events.description: A meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled to be held on August 19, 2026, inter alia, to consider and approve the proposal for fund raising by the Company.

Consider and approve  Dhanlaxmi Bank Limited Employee Stock Option Plan   2025  in accordance with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021, subject to the approval of the shareholders of the Bank.
Intimation of Board Meeting to be held on Wednesday, 19th August, 2026

GULFPETRO : 19-Aug-2026 :  The Company has informed the Exchange that a Board meeting to be held on August 14, 2026 has been re-scheduled. Further, the Company has informed the Exchange that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company will be held on August 19, 2026, To consider Fund Raising and other business matters. Trading Window will remain closed until 48 hours after the information become public.
Consideration and approval of Statement of unaudited consolidated/standalone financial results for the quarter and three months period ended 30 June 2026.
To consider and approve the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026
